_doc: Purely decorative map pieces (docs/art/classes/decorations.md): passable small decorations generated at 32x32 (critters) or 48x48 (patches) with the doodad class layer, and impassable props on 64x64 (one cell) or 128x64 (two cells side by side) with the prop class layer. generate-image-v2, no style image (like the doodads, trees and peaks of the same layer); one call returns many candidates of a mixed subject, the best distinct ones are accepted and cropped to their opaque box plus 1 px. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead.
